hk-3-2-4.scope: Planets — eight Solar System planets; 6,445 confirmed exoplanets in the NASA Exoplanet Archive, release 2026.10.08. The exoplanet count is a discovery catalogue, not the estimated cosmic population.

hk-3-5-2.scope: Cells — about 36 trillion in a reference adult male and 28 trillion in a reference adult female, Hatton et al. (2023); model-dependent individual counts, not cell-type counts or a total for all organisms.
hk-3-5-2.interpretation: Human cell populations are examples within this biology topic.
